definition_zh: 重建；重建物；复原；（语言学）构拟；重建时期
definition_en: the act or result of building something again, or of piecing together something that is no longer intact
core_image: 散落一地的碎石被按编号重新拼回一座拱门
scene: 这里指「重建」。 The reconstruction of the bridge took three years and twice the original budget.
sceneCN: 这里 reconstruction 指「实体重建」（第 1 个义项：把被毁的结构重新建起）；句意：这座桥的重建用了三年，花费是最初预算的两倍。图中可辨识物件：编号石块、拱门、吊车、图纸。

pos.zh: 重建；重建物；复原；（语言学）构拟；（美国史）重建时期（作专有名词时大写）

senses.title: Rebuilding a damaged structure
senses.titleCN: 实体重建：把被毁的建筑重新建起
senses.definition: the act of building again something that was destroyed or badly damaged
senses.definitionCN: 把被摧毁或严重损坏的事物重新建造起来的行动
senses.example: The reconstruction of the bridge took three years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的重建用了三年。
senses.why: The noun joins re- 'again' to construction, from Latin construere 'to pile up together', so it means piling the same structure up once more.
senses.whyCN: 该名词把 re-「再次」与 construction 结合，后者出自拉丁 construere「堆叠在一起」，因此意为把同一结构再堆起来一次。

senses.title: Recreating a past event
senses.titleCN: 事件还原：根据线索复原经过
senses.definition: the act of piecing together what happened from remaining evidence
senses.definitionCN: 根据残存证据把发生过的事情拼合出来
senses.example: Police reconstructed the accident from skid marks and camera footage.
senses.exampleCN: 警方根据刹车痕与监控画面还原了事故经过。
senses.why: The image shifts from stone to evidence: what is rebuilt is no longer a wall but a sequence of events.
senses.whyCN: 意象从石头转向证据：被重建的不再是一堵墙，而是一连串事件。

senses.title: Linguistic reconstruction
senses.titleCN: 语言构拟：由现存语言反推古语形式
senses.definition: in linguistics, the inferred recovery of an earlier language form from its surviving descendants
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中，从现存后代语言反推更早语言形式的做法
senses.example: The reconstruction of Proto-Indo-European rests on systematic sound correspondences.
senses.exampleCN: 原始印欧语的构拟依赖系统的语音对应关系。
senses.why: Linguists reconstruct a lost language the way engineers rebuild a bridge: from fragments, but with rules that constrain the guess.
senses.whyCN: 语言学家构拟已消失的语言，如同工程师重建桥梁：从残片出发，但用规则约束猜测。

senses.title: National rebuilding after war
senses.titleCN: 战后国家重建：修复社会与经济
senses.definition: the large-scale rebuilding of a country's buildings, economy and institutions after war or disaster
senses.definitionCN: 战争或灾难后对一个国家建筑、经济与制度的大规模重建
senses.example: Post-war reconstruction reshaped both the city and its politics.
senses.exampleCN: 战后重建同时重塑了这座城市及其政治。
senses.why: The building metaphor scales up: a nation is treated as a structure whose parts must be raised again together.
senses.whyCN: 建筑隐喻被放大：国家被当成一座结构，其各部分必须再次一起立起。

senses.title: Surgical reconstruction
senses.titleCN: 手术重建：修复身体结构
senses.definition: in medicine, surgery that rebuilds a body part damaged by injury, disease or congenital condition
senses.definitionCN: 医学中指重建因伤、病或先天状况受损的身体部位的手术
senses.example: Reconstruction of her jaw followed the removal of the tumour.
senses.exampleCN: 切除肿瘤之后，她接受了下颌重建手术。
senses.why: Medicine applies the word to flesh: the damaged part is rebuilt rather than merely repaired at the surface.
senses.whyCN: 医学把这个词用于身体：受损部位是被重建，而不只是表面修补。

senses.title: Image and signal reconstruction
senses.titleCN: 图像重建：由探测数据还原画面
senses.definition: in imaging and signal processing, the computation that turns raw detector measurements into a readable image
senses.definitionCN: 在成像与信号处理中，把探测器原始测量换算成可读图像的计算过程
senses.example: Image reconstruction turns detector signals into a readable CT scan.
senses.exampleCN: 图像重建把探测器信号变成可读的 CT 扫描图。
senses.why: Here reconstruction is mathematical: the object is not physically rebuilt, only recovered from data.
senses.whyCN: 这里的重建是数学性的：物体并未被物理重建，只是从数据中被还原出来。

senses.title: Memory reconstruction
senses.titleCN: 记忆重构：回忆是对过去的再拼装
senses.definition: in psychology, the view that remembering is an active rebuilding of past experience rather than a faithful replay
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中认为记忆是对过去经验的主动重建，而非忠实回放的观点
senses.example: Memory is partly a reconstruction, not a faithful recording.
senses.exampleCN: 记忆在某种程度上是重构，而不是忠实录音。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the building metaphor for the mind: recall selects and reassembles fragments, and the result may differ from the original.
senses.whyCN: 心理学把建筑隐喻借给心智：回忆挑选并重新拼合碎片，其结果可能与原初不同。

senses.title: The American Reconstruction era
senses.titleCN: 美国重建时期：南北战争后的政治阶段
senses.definition: in United States history, the period after the Civil War when the Union rebuilt the South's politics and society
senses.definitionCN: 美国历史中指南北战争后联邦重建南方政治与社会的时期
senses.example: The Reconstruction era left a long mark on voting rights.
senses.exampleCN: 重建时期在投票权问题上留下了长久印记。
senses.why: The proper noun applies the general word to a whole national project, and the capital R marks it as a named historical period.
senses.whyCN: 这个专有名词把一般词用于一项全国工程，大写 R 标明它是有名称的历史时期。

intro.en: Reconstruction is re- plus construction, and construction comes from Latin construere 'to pile up, build'. The word is an English formation on Latin materials rather than a direct Latin borrowing.
intro.cn: reconstruction 是 re- 加 construction，而 construction 出自拉丁 construere「堆积、建造」。该词是用拉丁材料在英语中构成的，并非直接借自拉丁。

items.en: Latin struere meant 'to pile up, build, arrange'. Its compounds include construere 'to build together' and destructure 'to tear down'.
items.cn: 拉丁 struere 意为「堆积、建造、安排」，其复合词包括 construere「一起建造」与 destructure「拆毁」。

items.en: Construere joined com- 'together' to struere, giving the image of materials piled into one structure; English construct comes from it.
items.cn: construere 把 com-「一起」加到 struere 上，形成「材料堆成一个结构」的意象；英语 construct 由此而来。

items.en: The prefix re- means 'again' or 'back'. Added to construction, it marks a second building of what already existed or was destroyed.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 意为「再次」或「回」。加到 construction 上，它标记对已存在或被毁之物进行第二次建造。

items.en: Reconstruction appears in English by the late eighteenth century; the exact first citation is uncertain.
items.cn: reconstruction 于 18 世纪晚期出现在英语中；最早确切书证存疑。

items.en: The nineteenth and twentieth centuries extended it to linguistic reconstruction, memory reconstruction and computed image reconstruction.
items.cn: 19 与 20 世纪把它扩展到语言构拟、记忆重构与计算图像重建。

items.en: The precise date of first English use and the earliest sense (physical rebuilding or figurative recovery) are uncertain.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代与最早义项）：英语首用确切年代以及最早义项（实体重建还是比喻性复原）均存疑。

note.en: The first group separates parts of the construct family; the second gives near-synonyms that stress restoring, recreating or remaking.
note.cn: 第一组区分 construct 词族的不同形式；第二组给出强调修复、再现或重制的近义词。

entries.definition: The original act of building. Reconstruction adds the idea of a second time after damage.
entries.definitionCN: 指最初的建造行为。reconstruction 增加了「受损后再来一次」的意思。

entries.definition: The verb 'to build', or a noun for an idea assembled from parts. It does not imply rebuilding.
entries.definitionCN: 动词「建造」，或指由部分拼合的观念；不含「重建」义。

entries.definition: To build again or piece together; reconstruction is the act or its result.
entries.definitionCN: 指重建或拼合；reconstruction 是动作或其结果。

entries.definition: Describing surgery or work that rebuilds a part; it modifies a noun rather than naming the process.
entries.definitionCN: 形容重建某部位的手术或工作；修饰名词，不命名过程本身。

entries.definition: Bringing something back to a former condition, often with fidelity to the original. Reconstruction may use new materials.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物恢复到从前的状态，常强调忠于原貌；reconstruction 可以使用新材料。

entries.definition: The everyday word for building again. It is narrower and rarely used for ideas or data.
entries.definitionCN: 日常用语，指再次建造；范围较窄，很少用于观念或数据。

entries.definition: Can mean the act of creating again, but usually means leisure activity. Context decides, and it is not a synonym for reconstruction.
entries.definitionCN: 可指再次创造，但通常指休闲活动；由语境决定，并非 reconstruction 的同义词。

entries.definition: The process of getting something back or returning to health. It stresses the return, not the rebuilding work.
entries.definitionCN: 指取回某物或恢复健康的过程，强调「回来」，而非重建工作。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- 'again' + construct 'pile up' + -ion: piling the same structure up again.
normal.cn: re-「再次」+ construct「堆起」+ -ion：把同一结构再堆一次。

normal.en: The family runs construct, construction, reconstruct, reconstructive, structure.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 construct、construction、reconstruct、reconstructive、structure。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: post-war reconstruction, linguistic reconstruction, image reconstruction, memory reconstruction.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：战后重建、语言构拟、图像重建、记忆重构。

normal.en: A reconstruction can be physical, evidentiary, linguistic, surgical or computational.
normal.cn: 重建可以是实体的、证据性的、语言的、手术的或计算的。

normal.en: The capital-R Reconstruction names a US historical period, not any ordinary rebuilding.
normal.cn: 大写 Reconstruction 指美国一个历史时期，而非任何普通重建。

abstract.en: Picture numbered fragments of an arch laid out on the floor, waiting to be fitted back together.
abstract.cn: 想象拱门的编号碎片摊在地上，等待被重新拼合。

abstract.en: Picture a detective arranging photographs on a board until the order of events appears.
abstract.cn: 想象侦探在板上排列照片，直到事件顺序浮现。

abstract.en: Picture a scanner circling a body and a computer drawing the inside from echoes.
abstract.cn: 想象扫描仪绕着人体旋转，计算机据回声画出内部。

examples.en: The reconstruction of the cathedral used stone from the original quarry.
examples.cn: 大教堂的重建使用了原采石场的石料。

examples.en: Historians' reconstruction of the battle depends on letters from both sides.
examples.cn: 历史学家对这场战役的还原依赖双方的来信。

examples.en: Memory reconstruction can add details that were never present.
examples.cn: 记忆重构可能加入从未存在过的细节。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）+ construction（建造）」——再建一遍 → reconstruction 重建、复原

root: 拉丁 struere「堆积、建造」→ construere「一起建造」→ 英语 construct / construction；加 re-「再次」与 -ion 构成 reconstruction。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses rebuild different things: a bridge, an event, a lost language, a nation, a body, an image, a memory, and a historical era.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项重建的对象各不相同：一座桥、一起事件、一门失传语言、一个国家、一具身体、一幅图像、一段记忆，以及一个历史时期。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: numbered fragments of an arch fitted back into one structure.
core.cn: 核心意象：带编号的拱门碎片被重新拼成一个结构。

branches.en: STONE AND EVENTS: either a physical structure or a sequence of happenings is put back together.
branches.cn: 石头与事件：或是一个实体结构，或是一串发生之事被重新拼合。

branches.en: LOST LANGUAGE: fragments of descendants constrain the inferred ancestor.
branches.cn: 失传语言：后代语言的碎片约束对祖语的推断。

branches.en: NATION: a whole society is rebuilt, whether as a general project or a named era.
branches.cn: 国家：整个社会被重建，或作为一般工程，或作为有名称的时代。

branches.en: BODY: surgery rebuilds a damaged part rather than merely patching its surface.
branches.cn: 身体：手术重建受损部位，而不只是修补表面。

branches.en: DATA AND MIND: computation or recall reassembles a whole from fragments, without physical rebuilding.
branches.cn: 数据与心智：计算或回忆由碎片重组整体，并无物理重建。

intro.en: Reconstruction stacks three layers: the Latin verb struere 'pile up', the English noun construction, and the prefix re- 'again' plus -ion.
intro.cn: reconstruction 叠了三层：拉丁动词 struere「堆积」、英语名词 construction，再加前缀 re-「再次」与 -ion。

latinIntro.en: The struere family includes structure, construct, construction, destruct, instruct, obstruct and instrument, all built on the image of piling or arranging materials.
latinIntro.cn: struere 词族包括 structure、construct、construction、destruct、instruct、obstruct、instrument，都建立在堆积或安排材料的意象上。

items.meaning: the act or result of building again
items.example: The reconstruction of the school finished ahead of schedule.

items.meaning: to build again or piece together
items.example: Engineers reconstructed the failed joint in a test rig.
items.exampleCN: 工程师在试验台上重建了失效的接点。

items.meaning: the act of building; a structure
items.example: Construction of the tunnel began in spring.
items.exampleCN: 隧道的建造在春季开始。

items.example: They constructed a model from cardboard.
items.exampleCN: 他们用纸板搭了一个模型。

items.meaning: an arranged whole; the arrangement itself
to build knowledge into someone; to teach
items.meaningCN: 把知识建构进某人；教导
items.example: The manual instructs users to oil the hinge.
items.exampleCN: 手册指导用户给铰链上油。

items.meaning: to build in the way; to block

items.example: The command destructs the old archive.

definition_zh: adj. 互补的；补充的
definition_en: combining well so that each supplies what the other lacks
core_image: 钥匙与锁孔刚好对上，缺一不可
scene: 这两种药作用互补，医生常一起开。 The two drugs are complementary, so doctors often prescribe both.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：complementary 指互补的；句意是这两种药作用互补，医生常一起开。

pos.zh: 互补的；补充的

senses.title: Filling what the other lacks
senses.definition: combining with something so that the pair works better
senses.definitionCN: 与另一物合起来效果更好
senses.example: Their skills are complementary.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的技能互补。
senses.why: Latin complere means to fill up.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 complere 意为填满。

senses.title: Used alongside standard treatment
senses.definition: used in addition to, not instead of, the main method
senses.definitionCN: 作为主要方法之外的附加手段
senses.example: She studies complementary medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 她研究补充医学。
senses.why: Medicine gave the word this narrower sense.
senses.whyCN: 医学界赋予它这一较窄的义项。

intro.en: Complementary comes from a Latin verb meaning to fill up.
intro.cn: complementary 源自拉丁语「填满」的动词。

items.en: Plere means to fill.
items.cn: plere 意为填满。

items.en: Complere means to fill up completely.
items.cn: complere 意为完全填满。

items.en: It names what completes a thing.
items.cn: 该词指使事物完整者。

items.en: Complementary describes things that complete each other.
items.cn: 十七世纪 complementary 形容互相补足之物。

items.en: Colour theory fixed the sense of paired hues.
items.cn: 十九世纪色彩理论固定了配对色之义。

note.en: The look-alike group contrasts the two spellings; the near-meaning group names pairing.
note.cn: 形近组对比两种拼写；近义组列出配对关系。

entries.definition: Expressing praise or free.
entries.definitionCN: 赞美的；免费的。

entries.definition: Something that completes.
entries.definitionCN: 补充物。

entries.definition: The act of finishing.
entries.definitionCN: 完成。

entries.definition: Going well together.
entries.definitionCN: 相配的。

entries.definition: Added to complete something.
entries.definitionCN: 补充的。

entries.definition: Given and returned equally.
entries.definitionCN: 相互的。

normalIntro.en: Complementary things fill each other out.
normalIntro.cn: complementary 之物互相补足。

normal.en: Plere means to fill.
normal.cn: plere 意为填满。

normal.en: Complere means to fill up.
normal.cn: complere 意为填满。

normal.en: Complement is what completes.
normal.cn: complement 是补全之物。

normal.en: Complementary means completing each other.
normal.cn: complementary 意为互相补全。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with complimentary.
normal.cn: 别与 complimentary（赞美的）混淆。

abstract.en: A key and its lock.
abstract.cn: 钥匙与锁。

abstract.en: Two dancers balanced.
abstract.cn: 相互平衡的两名舞者。

abstract.en: Blue beside orange.
abstract.cn: 橙色旁的蓝色。

examples.en: The two approaches are complementary.
examples.cn: 这两种方法互补。

examples.en: They have complementary strengths.
examples.cn: 他们的长处互补。

examples.en: The clinic offers complementary therapy.
examples.cn: 这家诊所提供补充疗法。

dict_mnemonic.text: complement（补足）+ -ary（…的）→ 能互相补足的，即互补的。

root: 拉丁 com（完全）+ plere（填满）→ complementum → complement → complementary

sensesIntro.en: A pair that completes each other, and a treatment added beside another.
sensesIntro.cn: 彼此补全的一对，以及附加于另一种疗法之旁的疗法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a key turning perfectly in its lock
core.cn: 核心意象：钥匙在锁孔里恰好转动

branches.en: Blue and orange side by side.
branches.cn: 并排的蓝与橙。

branches.en: One plans, the other builds.
branches.cn: 一个规划，一个施工。

branches.en: Massage offered beside surgery.
branches.cn: 手术之外提供的按摩。

branches.en: A clinic with two kinds of care.
branches.cn: 提供两类护理的诊所。

branches.en: What is added to make a whole.
branches.cn: 为成全整体而增添之物。

intro.en: Complementary is built from filling pieces; the list adds completion words.
intro.cn: complementary 由「填满」词素构成；下面列出补全词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin plere is to fill, complere is to fill up, and complementum is a completion.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 plere 意为填满，complere 意为填满，complementum 意为补全。

latinEntries.exampleCN: complere 产生 complete 与 complement。
plere 促成 complete 与 supply。
complementum 产生 complement 与 complementary。

definition_zh: adv. 飞快地；迅速地；不停地（书面语）
definition_en: Quickly or at a fast pace; a literary adverb used of work, change or growth that continues rapidly and without pause.
core_image: 脚步不停，事情一件接一件往前赶
scene: 改造工程推进得比预期快得多。 The renovation work is proceeding apace.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：工程进展迅速、一刻不停，书面语用 apace 描述这种「快步推进」的状态。

pos.zh: 飞快地；迅速地；不停地

forms.label: 无比较级与最高级（副词）

senses.title: Quickly, at speed
senses.definition: at a fast speed, used especially of work or progress in formal or literary writing
senses.definitionCN: 以很快的速度，尤用于正式或书面文字中描述工作或进展
senses.example: Preparations for the summit went ahead apace.
senses.exampleCN: 峰会的筹备工作快速推进。
senses.why: The word is a- plus pace, literally at a pace, so the picture is of legs moving steadily rather than of a sudden burst.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 a- 加 pace，字面为「以某种步速」，所以画面是双腿持续迈动，而不是突然爆发。

senses.title: Without pause, steadily onward
senses.definition: continuing rapidly and without interruption, the sense carried by proceed apace and continue apace
senses.definitionCN: 快速而不中断地持续，是 proceed apace 与 continue apace 所承载的含义
senses.example: Despite the funding gap, the research continued apace.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管经费有缺口，研究仍在不停推进。
senses.why: The prefix a- means on or in a state of, so the adverb stresses that the pace is kept up, not merely that it is high.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 a- 意为「在……状态中」，所以这个副词强调的是步速被保持住，而不只是步速很高。

intro.en: Apace is a- plus pace, from Middle English a pas, at a pace. Pace comes from Old French pas, from Latin passus, a step, from pandere, to stretch the leg.
intro.cn: apace 是 a- 加 pace，来自中古英语 a pas「以某种步速」。pace 来自古法语 pas，后者出自拉丁语 passus「一步」，而 passus 又来自 pandere「伸腿」。

items.en: Latin pandere meant to stretch or spread, and in walking it described stretching the leg out for a stride.
items.cn: 拉丁语 pandere 意为「伸展、展开」，在行走语境中指伸腿迈出一步。

items.en: Passus was the noun for a step or a pace, and also a Roman measure of about five feet. It gives pace, pass and passage.
items.cn: passus 是表示「一步、步幅」的名词，也是罗马约五英尺的长度单位。它产生 pace、pass 与 passage。

items.en: Old French pas kept the sense of a step, and the phrase a pas meant at a pace, at a walking rate.
items.cn: 古法语 pas 保留「一步」之义，短语 a pas 意为「以某种步速」，即按行走的速度。

items.en: Middle English wrote a pas as two words, with a- meaning on or in, the same prefix seen in asleep and abroad.
items.cn: 中古英语把 a pas 写成两个词，a- 意为「在……之中」，与 asleep、abroad 中的前缀相同。

items.en: The two words fused into apace, now a literary adverb used mainly with proceed, continue, grow and change.
items.cn: 两个词合成为 apace，如今是书面副词，主要与 proceed、continue、grow、change 连用。

note.en: The look-alike group warns against apiece, which means each, and appease, to calm; the near-meaning group lists other adverbs of speed.
note.cn: 形近组提醒别与 apiece「每个」和 appease「平息」混淆；近义组列出其他表示速度的副词。

entries.definition: The speed of walking or progress.
entries.definitionCN: 行走或进展的速度。

entries.definition: An empty area or interval.
entries.definitionCN: 空白区域或间隔。

entries.definition: For each one; per item.
entries.definitionCN: 每个；按件计。

entries.definition: To calm someone by giving in.
entries.definitionCN: 通过让步平息某人。

entries.definition: At a fast speed.
entries.definitionCN: 以很快的速度。

entries.definition: With great speed.
entries.definitionCN: 以极快的速度。

entries.definition: Smoothly and fast.
entries.definitionCN: 流畅而快速地。

entries.definition: In an energetic, quick manner.
entries.definitionCN: 以精力充沛而快速的方式。

normalIntro.en: Apace is a- plus pace: at a pace, so the legs keep moving without a stop.
normalIntro.cn: apace 就是 a- 加 pace：以某种步速，所以双腿不停迈动。

normal.en: It is literary: in speech say quickly, in writing say apace.
normal.cn: 它偏书面：口语说 quickly，书面可说 apace。

normal.en: The common partners are proceed, continue, grow and change.
normal.cn: 常见搭配动词是 proceed、continue、grow、change。

normal.en: It goes after the verb, not before: work proceeded apace.
normal.cn: 它放在动词之后，不放在前面：work proceeded apace。

normal.en: Do not confuse apace with apiece, which means each.
normal.cn: 别把 apace 与 apiece「每个」混淆。

normal.en: There is no comparative: not more apace in ordinary use.
normal.cn: 一般不用比较级：不说 more apace。

abstract.en: Picture a line of workers moving without a break.
abstract.cn: 想象一队工人不停歇地推进。

abstract.en: Imagine a runner holding the same stride for an hour.
abstract.cn: 想象一个跑者一小时保持同一步幅。

abstract.en: Think of scaffolding rising a floor each week.
abstract.cn: 想象脚手架每周升高一层。

examples.en: The rebuilding of the harbour proceeded apace.
examples.cn: 港口的重建快速推进。

examples.en: Rumours spread apace through the village.
examples.cn: 谣言在村里迅速传开。

examples.en: Work continues apace despite the weather.
examples.cn: 尽管天气不佳，工作仍在不停推进。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：a「在……中」+ pace「步速」——一直在步速里，脚步不停，就是飞快地、迅速地 apace。

root: 拉丁语 pandere「伸腿」生出 passus「一步」，古法语作 pas，中古英语 a pas「以某种步速」合成为 apace，字面即「保持在步速之中」，引申为迅速而不停。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses are one kept-up stride: high speed, and the same speed maintained without a pause.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项是同一种被保持住的步幅：速度很快，以及同一速度不停歇地维持下去。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: legs that never stop moving, task after task
core.cn: 核心意象：脚步不停，事情一件接一件往前赶

branches.en: A harbour rebuilt in one season.
branches.cn: 一个季度内重建完成的港口。

branches.en: Rumours crossing a village by noon.
branches.cn: 中午前就传遍村子的谣言。

branches.en: Research kept up through a funding gap.
branches.cn: 经费缺口期间仍不停的研究。

branches.en: Scaffolding rising a floor each week.
branches.cn: 每周升高一层的脚手架。

branches.en: Both keep the same stride going.
branches.cn: 两者都让同一步幅持续下去。

intro.en: Apace is the prefix a- plus pace, and the step root pass- also builds pass, passage and compass.
intro.cn: apace 是前缀 a- 加 pace，「步」词根 pass- 还构成 pass、passage 与 compass。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is passus, a step, from pandere, to stretch; the prefix a- is native English, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语层次是 passus「一步」，来自 pandere「伸展」；前缀 a- 是英语本族的，不是拉丁语。

latinEntries.exampleCN: pandere 是 passus 的来源。
pas 传入英语成为 pace。

definition_zh: 水电；水力（由水流转换而来的电力）
definition_en: electric power produced by converting the energy of falling or flowing water
core_image: 厂房里的水轮机带着发电机持续旋转，厂房外是奔流的河水
scene: 山间河道被引到厂房一侧，落下的水流推着水轮持续旋转。 The old mill now sells hydropower to the nearby town.
sceneCN: 这里 hydropower 指「由水力转换而来的电力」（第 1 个义项：水流推动涡轮、带动发电机后得到的电）；句意为这座老磨坊如今向邻近城镇出售水电。图中可辨识物件：引水渠、水轮机、发电机、通往镇上的电线。

pos.zh: 水电；水力（不可数）

forms.label: 复数（罕见，指多种水电系统）

senses.title: Electricity made from water
senses.definition: electric power generated when falling or flowing water drives a turbine and generator
senses.definitionCN: 落水或流水驱动涡轮与发电机时产生的电力
senses.example: The old mill now sells hydropower to the nearby town.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老磨坊如今向邻近城镇出售水电。
senses.why: hydro- names water and power names the rate of doing work, so the compound means work-rate delivered by water.
senses.whyCN: hydro- 指水，power 指做功的速率，因此复合词意为「由水交付的做功速率」。

senses.title: The resource and installed capacity
senses.definition: the water-power available at a site or already built into plants, counted in plans
senses.definitionCN: 某地可获得的水力，或已建成电站的能力，计入规划
senses.example: The province doubled its hydropower in a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 该省在十年内把水电装机容量翻了一倍。
senses.why: planners count a natural flow as a stock, so the word also names the capacity rather than only the current.
senses.whyCN: 规划者把自然流动当作存量，因此这个词也指容量，而不只是电流。

senses.title: Mechanical power from water
senses.definition: the turning force of a water wheel used directly for milling, pumping or lifting
senses.definitionCN: 水轮产生的转动力，直接用于磨粉、抽水或提升
senses.example: The museum's wheel produced hydropower for the loom.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆的水轮为织机提供水力。
senses.why: the word predates electricity in spirit: power first meant mechanical force, and water supplied it long before generators.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在精神上早于电力：power 最初指机械力，而水在发电机出现之前早已提供它。

senses.title: A sector of the energy industry
senses.titleCN: 能源产业中的一个门类
senses.definition: the companies, contracts and regulations that build and run water-power stations
senses.definitionCN: 建造与运营水电站的公司、合同与法规
senses.example: Hydropower employs thousands of engineers in the region.
senses.exampleCN: 水电在该地区雇用数千名工程师。
senses.why: an energy source becomes an industry when it has its own firms, tariffs and trade bodies.
senses.whyCN: 当一种能源有了自己的公司、电价与行业协会，它就成为一个产业。

senses.title: A plant type with low storage
senses.titleCN: 一种少蓄水的电站类型
senses.definition: a station class, such as run-of-river, that uses the current flow without a large reservoir
senses.definitionCN: 一类电站，如径流式，利用当前流量而不建大型水库
senses.example: Run-of-river hydropower leaves the river's pace nearly unchanged.
senses.exampleCN: 径流式水电几乎不改变河流的流速。
senses.why: engineering divides the field by how water is held, and the word labels those divisions.
senses.whyCN: 工程学按蓄水方式划分领域，这个词就用来标注这些划分。

senses.title: Hydraulic power in physics
senses.definition: the power delivered by a fluid, calculated from flow rate and pressure or head
senses.definitionCN: 流体交付的功率，由流量与压力或水头算出
senses.example: The formula links hydropower to head and discharge.
senses.exampleCN: 该公式把水力功率与水头及流量联系起来。
senses.why: physics keeps power as a rate and replaces the river with two variables, head and discharge.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把 power 保留为速率，并把河流换成两个变量：水头与流量。

senses.title: The emblem of steady clean power
senses.titleCN: 稳定清洁电力的象征义
senses.definition: a symbol in debate for power that is both low-carbon and available on demand
senses.definitionCN: 讨论中象征既低碳又能按需调用的电力
senses.example: Hydropower became the anchor of the clean-energy plan.
senses.exampleCN: 水电成了这份清洁能源计划的锚。
senses.why: unlike sun and wind, a reservoir can be switched on, so the word stands for reliability as well as cleanliness.
senses.whyCN: 与太阳和风不同，水库可以随时开启，因此这个词既代表清洁也代表可靠。

senses.title: Power borrowed from an existing head

senses.definition: any advantage converted into force because it already sits higher than its surroundings

intro.en: Hydropower joins Greek hydro- 'water' with power, a noun that reached English through Old French from Latin posse 'to be able'. The compound is a nineteenth-century technical term. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: hydropower 把希腊语 hydro-「水」与 power 组合起来；power 经古法语来自拉丁语 posse「能够」。这个复合词是 19 世纪的技术术语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hydōr was the Greek noun for water. Its Indo-European source is a reconstruction, so the pre-Greek shape is not attested directly.
items.cn: hydōr 是希腊语中表示水的名词。其印欧语来源属于重构形式，因此希腊语之前的形态没有直接实证。

items.en: Hydro- became the standard combining form for water in science, from hydraulics to hydrosphere.
items.cn: hydro- 成为科学中表示水的标准组合形式，从 hydraulics 到 hydrosphere。

items.en: Posse 'to be able' was contracted from potis 'able' plus esse 'to be'; the origin of potis itself is not fully settled.
items.cn: posse「能够」由 potis「有能力的」加 esse「是」缩合而成；potis 本身的来源尚无定论。

items.en: Vulgar Latin potere reshaped posse, and Old French poeir passed the noun and verb into English as power and pouvoir's cousins.
items.cn: 通俗拉丁语 potere 重塑了 posse，古法语 poeir 把名词与动词传入英语，成为 power 及其同类。

items.en: Hydropower was coined in the nineteenth century, when water wheels were being fitted with generators and the output was sold as power.
items.cn: hydropower 于 19 世纪被造出，当时水轮开始装配发电机，产出作为电力出售。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Greek source of hydōr and the origin of potis are both unsettled, and the first printed use of the compound is not fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：hydōr 的希腊语之前来源与 potis 的来源都无定论，这个复合词的最早书证也没有定说。

note.en: Group one holds words that share hydro- or power and are easily mistaken for this noun; group two holds other names for water-derived power.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 hydro- 或 power、容易被误当作本词的词；第二组是水能动力的其他名称。

entries.definition: The adjective describing a plant or process that makes current from water; hydropower is the noun for the power itself.
entries.definitionCN: 描述用水发电的电站或过程的形容词；hydropower 是动力本身的名称。

entries.definition: The noun for the electricity specifically; it stresses the product, while hydropower can also stress capacity or mechanical force.
entries.definitionCN: 专指所发电流的名词；它强调产品，而 hydropower 也可强调容量或机械力。

entries.definition: A unit for measuring engine output, originally based on a horse's work; it measures power but says nothing about water.
entries.definitionCN: 计量发动机输出的单位，最初以马的工作量为基准；它测量功率，却与水源无关。

entries.definition: The facility where power is generated; a hydropower plant is one kind of power plant.
entries.definitionCN: 发电的场所；水电站是发电厂的一种。

entries.definition: The everyday term for power from water, including mills; it is broader and less technical than hydropower.
entries.definitionCN: 指水力的日常说法，包括磨坊；比 hydropower 更宽泛、技术性更弱。

entries.definition: Power from tides rather than from a river's fall; the turbines are similar but the driving cycle is the moon.
entries.definitionCN: 来自潮汐而非河流落差的动力；涡轮相似，但驱动周期来自月亮。

entries.definition: A hydropower method that pumps water uphill when power is cheap and lets it fall when demand is high.
entries.definitionCN: 一种水电方式：电力便宜时把水抽上山，需求高时再让其落下。

entries.definition: The wider class that includes water, wind, solar and biomass; hydropower is one member.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽的类别，包含水能、风能、太阳能与生物质能；水电是其中一员。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: hydro- 'water' + power 'work-rate': the compound literally names the rate at which water does work.
normal.cn: hydro-「水」+ power「做功速率」：复合词字面就是水做功的速率。

normal.en: The family runs hydropower, hydroelectric, hydroelectricity, hydraulic, hydrosphere.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 hydropower、hydroelectric、hydroelectricity、hydraulic、hydrosphere。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the plant: hydropower station, hydropower plant, hydropower capacity.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出电站：水电站、水力发电厂、水电装机容量。

normal.en: Latin posse 'to be able' is the ancestor of power, so power is literally ability.
normal.cn: 拉丁 posse「能够」是 power 的祖先，所以 power 字面上就是能力。

normal.en: Run-of-river hydropower is the term for a station that does not hold a large reservoir.
normal.cn: 径流式水电指不建大型水库的电站，这是该词在工程中的固定用法。

abstract.cn: 想象一条河上夜班，却从不讨工钱。

abstract.en: Picture a reservoir as a bank where the currency is height.
abstract.cn: 想象一座水库是银行，里面的货币是高度。

abstract.en: Picture a hill that lends its slope to every machine below.
abstract.cn: 想象一座山把自己的坡度借给下方每一台机器。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one drop: water is held, falls, spins a turbine, drives a generator, leaves as current, and the same word then names capacity, mechanical force, a sector, a plant type, a physical rate, a clean emblem and a borrowed advantage.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次落水展开：水被蓄起、落下、转动涡轮、带动发电机、以电流送出，随后同一词用来命名容量、机械力、产业、电站类型、物理速率、清洁象征与借来的优势。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a river led into a machine hall where falling water keeps a turbine spinning.
core.cn: 核心意象：河水被引进机房，落下的水让涡轮持续旋转。

branches.en: PHYSICAL RATE: falling water delivers power, whether measured at the meter or in a formula.
branches.cn: 物理速率：落水交付功率，无论是在电表上测量还是在公式里计算。

branches.en: STOCK AND SHAFT: the same word names installed capacity and the direct turning of an old wheel.
branches.cn: 存量与转轴：同一词既指装机容量，也指老水轮的直接转动。

branches.en: SECTOR AND PLANT TYPE: firms and regulations form an industry, and engineering divides it by how water is held.
branches.cn: 产业与电站类型：公司与法规构成行业，工程学再按蓄水方式划分。

branches.en: CLEAN AND STEADY: a reservoir can be switched on, so the word stands for reliable clean power.
branches.cn: 清洁且稳定：水库可以随时开启，因此这个词代表可靠的清洁电力。

branches.en: BORROWED HEIGHT: any existing advantage can act as the head that drives a machine.
branches.cn: 借来的高度：任何既有优势都可充当驱动机械的水头。

intro.en: Hydropower is a compound of a Greek combining form and a Latin-derived noun. Both halves are common word-forming elements, so the word can be read as 'water' plus 'work-rate'.
intro.cn: hydropower 是希腊组合形式与拉丁来源名词的复合。两半都是常见的构词成分，因此这个词可读作「水」加「做功速率」。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 posse 与 potentia 衍生 power、powerful、powerless 与 empower；希腊 hydōr 衍生 hydro- 与 hydraulics。
